drawing: 4-drawer chest, overall 900×450×940 (dimension lines on the iso view on p3: 900 wide, 450 deep, 940 high). Sides 2/3 (416 deep × 924 high) reach the floor on adjustable feet I (2 per side, step 9); top 1 (900×450) lies ON the sides (924+16=940), ~10 overhang each end; pilasters 4 (44×924) on the front edges of the sides (short dowels K). Bottom 5 (848×416) between the sides, raised above the floor (sides show as legs with a recess under the bottom, like the rest of Parma). Shelf 6 (848×416) fixed between the sides at mid-height, between drawers 2 and 3 (dust board); bar 7 (848×80) under the top at the back; царга 14 (848×200) a horizontal rear rail at mid-height behind the shelf. 4 equal drawers stacked from bottom 5 to the top: overlay fronts 8 (844×200, bevel-framed), sides 9/10 (350×160), back 11 (790×160), ДВП bottom 13 (818×355) screwed under (≈150 pitch, step 6) with a longitudinal bar 12 (350×90) under the middle of each bottom (step 5; its colour may differ from the visible surfaces); one pair ball runners J per drawer (4 per side on the side panels, step 10). 1 knob H per drawer at the centre near the top edge (4x12 screw P). Back ДВП, top to bottom: 15 (876×209), 16 (876×313), [царга 14 at the joint], 16 (876×313). No orthographic front view.
